name: io.github.ABGEO/georgia-mcp
title: Georgia MCP
description: An MCP server for Georgian public data, read from the organizations that publish it.

tools.name: air_get_quality
tools.description: Returns the newest air quality readings of the automatic stations of the National Environmental Agency of Georgia (NEA), for a city, one station, or every station. Each reading gives PM10, PM2.5, NO2, O3, SO2, or CO, its concentration (µg/m³, CO in mg/m³), its hour, and its level: good, fair, moderate, poor, or very_poor. A station level is its worst reading. Stations come worst first. A reading older than 24 hours is left out. The NEA stamps some readings a few hours ahead of the clock: the time is as published. Data from the NEA.

city.description: A city of Georgia in English or Georgian, for example Tbilisi or რუსთავი. Leave city and station empty for every station.

station.description: A station code of the NEA, for example TSRT. Give a city or a station, not both.

language.description: The language of the addresses and the cities: ka or en. The default is en.

limit.description: The maximum count of stations, 1 to 100. The default is 25.

tools.name: air_list_history
tools.description: Returns the hourly readings of one station of the National Environmental Agency of Georgia (NEA) over at most 7 days of the last 7, newest first, with the level of each reading. The default is the last 24 hours. Call air_get_quality first to find the station code. The NEA stamps some readings a few hours ahead of the clock: the time is as published. Data from the NEA.

station.description: A station code of the NEA, for example TSRT.

from.description: The first date of the period, YYYY-MM-DD, at most 7 days ago. Give from and to, or neither for the last 24 hours.

to.description: The last date of the period, YYYY-MM-DD. At most 7 days with from, counted with both ends.

pollutant.description: One pollutant: PM10, PM2.5, NO2, O3, SO2, or CO. The default is every pollutant of the station.

language.description: The language of the address and the city: ka or en. The default is en.

limit.description: The maximum count of readings of each pollutant, newest first, 1 to 100. The default is 24.

tools.name: cinema_get_seat_map
tools.description: Returns the seats of the hall of one session of Cavea that has not started: each row, each seat with its class, a mark for a taken seat, and a mark for special needs. Gives the count of free seats and the price in lari of each seat class. The server reads the map at each call. It reserves no seat. A person buys the ticket on cavea.ge. Data from the web site of Cavea, cavea.ge.

language.description: The language of the names and the texts: ka or en. The default is en.

session.description: The session code from cinema_list_sessions, for example cag_5/27-10-2026/22:15.

tools.name: cinema_list_cinemas
tools.description: Lists the open cinemas of Cavea, in Tbilisi and Batumi. Returns the code, the name, the city, and the address of each cinema. Use the code in cinema_list_sessions. Data from the web site of Cavea, cavea.ge.

language.description: The language of the names and the texts: ka or en. The default is en.

tools.name: cinema_list_movies
tools.description: Lists the movies that Cavea shows now, or the movies coming soon. Returns the code, the name, the genres, the duration in minutes, the age rating, the premiere, the directors, the actors, and a description of each movie. Use the code in cinema_list_sessions. Data from the web site of Cavea, cavea.ge.

language.description: The language of the names and the texts: ka or en. The default is en.

status.description: now_showing or coming_soon. The default is now_showing.

limit.description: The maximum count of movies, 1 to 100. The default is 50.

tools.name: cinema_list_sessions
tools.description: Lists the sessions of the movies of Cavea on one date that have not started, in the order of the start time. Narrow the list by a movie, a cinema, an audio language, or a format. Returns the cinema, the hall, the start time, the languages, the formats, the price in lari, and the occupancy level of each session. With a movie, each session has the price of each seat class. With no movie, it has the price of the class Standard. Use the session code in cinema_get_seat_map. Data from the web site of Cavea, cavea.ge.

language.description: The language of the names and the texts: ka or en. The default is en.

movie.description: The code of a movie from cinema_list_movies or cinema_search_movies.

date.description: The date in Tbilisi, YYYY-MM-DD. The default is today. Cavea publishes about 3 days.

cinema.description: The code of a cinema from cinema_list_cinemas.

audio_language.description: The language of the sound: ka or en.

format.description: One format: 3d, imax, dolby_atmos, screenx, or infinity_vision.

limit.description: The maximum count of sessions, 1 to 100. The default is 30.

tools.name: cinema_search_movies
tools.description: Finds the movies of Cavea, now showing or coming soon, by a part of the English name. Give the text in English: Cavea does not match a Georgian name. Returns the code, the name, the status, the duration in minutes, and the age rating of each movie. Data from the web site of Cavea, cavea.ge.

language.description: The language of the names and the texts: ka or en. The default is en.

query.description: A part of the English name of the movie, 2 to 100 characters.

limit.description: The maximum count of movies, 1 to 100. The default is 20.

tools.name: energy_get_balance
tools.description: Returns the monthly electricity balance of Georgia from the Georgian National Energy and Water Supply Regulatory Commission (GNERC): the generation by type of power plant, the import and the export by country, the supply, the consumption by group, the losses, the domestic consumption, and the transit, in million kWh, for one month from 2022-01, or the total of one year from 2022. GNERC publishes a month about three weeks after it ends. With no input, it returns the newest published month. A year that is not over holds only its published months: see months. Data from GNERC.

month.description: A month from 2022-01, as YYYY-MM, for example 2026-03. Leave month and year empty for the newest published month.

year.description: A year from 2022, for the total of the year. Do not give it with month.

tools.name: energy_get_grid
tools.description: Returns the state of the electricity grid of Georgia from Georgian State Electrosystem (GSE), the operator of the transmission grid: the generation of the hydro, thermal, wind, and solar power plants, the total generation, the consumption, and the flow on the lines to each neighbor country, in MW, with the frequency in Hz. Each value is the average of 3 minutes. A positive flow is an import, a negative flow an export. Each value carries the quality code of GSE: only ACT is a measurement. Give a moment to read the grid at a time in the last 31 days. The names are in English. Data from GSE.

moment.description: A moment in the last 31 days: 2026-11-16T13:00 for a time of Tbilisi, or RFC 3339 with an offset, for example 2026-11-16T09:00:00Z. Leave it empty for the newest grid state.

tools.name: energy_list_prices
tools.description: Returns three monthly electricity prices of Georgia from the Georgian National Energy and Water Supply Regulatory Commission (GNERC), in tetri per kWh: the weighted average price of balancing electricity, the guaranteed capacity fee, and the price of the deregulated power plants. Give a period of at most 60 months from 2015-01. With no input, it returns the last 12 published months. Data from GNERC.

from.description: The first month, YYYY-MM, from 2015-01. Leave it empty for 11 months before to.

to.description: The last month, YYYY-MM. Leave it empty for the newest published month.

tools.name: fuel_get_prices
tools.description: Returns the current fuel prices of Georgian fuel companies: the price in GEL of one unit of each product. Use it for the price of petrol, diesel, or gas at a company today, or to compare companies. Each product has a grade that every company shares: regular (litre), premium (litre), super (litre), super_100 (litre), diesel (litre), cng (cubic_metre), lpg (litre), other (litre). price: the price in GEL of one unit at a station with an attendant. self_service_price: the price in GEL of one unit at a self-service station of the same company. A product with no self_service_price has none. The fuel companies of this server: connect (Connect, publishes no effective date), gulf (Gulf), lukoil (Lukoil), neogas (Neogas, publishes no effective date), portal (Portal, publishes no effective date), rompetrol (Rompetrol, publishes no effective date), socar (SOCAR, publishes no effective date), wissol (Wissol). The prices are of today. The tool has no history.

grades.description: Grades: regular, premium, super, super_100, diesel, cng, lpg, other. Empty asks every grade.

companies.description: Fuel company codes. Empty asks every company. The description of the tool lists the codes.

language.description: The language of the product names: ka or en. The default is en.

tools.name: holidays_get_day
tools.description: Tells whether one date is a public holiday in Georgia, with its weekday and the holiday name in Georgian or English. The default date is today in Georgia. It supports the years from 2025 to the next year. A one-off day off that the government declares by decree is not in the data: a false answer does not rule one out. Data from Nager.Date.

date.description: The date, YYYY-MM-DD. The default is today in Georgia.

language.description: The language of the holiday name: ka or en. The default is en.

tools.name: holidays_list_holidays
tools.description: Returns the public holidays of Georgia: every holiday of one year, or the next holidays on or after a date. Each holiday gives its date (YYYY-MM-DD), its weekday, and its name in Georgian or English. With no input, it returns every holiday of the current year in Georgia. It supports the years from 2025 to the next year. The list holds no one-off day off that the government declares by decree. Data from Nager.Date.

year.description: The year, from 2025 to the next year. The default is the current year. Give a year or from, not both.

from.description: A date, YYYY-MM-DD. The tool returns the next holidays on or after it, up to limit.

limit.description: The maximum count of holidays with from, 1 to 20. The default is 1. A year returns every holiday.

language.description: The language of the holiday names: ka or en. The default is en.

tools.name: law_get_act
tools.description: Returns one legal act of the Legislative Herald (matsne.gov.ge) by its identifier from law_search_acts. With no article, returns the metadata, the newest 20 consolidated versions with their publication dates, the count of every version, and the table of contents. With articles, returns the full text of at most 10 articles, for example 82 or 133^3 (article 133 with the superscript 3). Give a version number or a date to read the act as it stood then; the default is the newest version, or in English the newest translated version. A version date is its publication date, not the date it took effect. The Georgian text is the only official text; an English text is a translation, and not every act has one. Data from the Legislative Herald of Georgia.

id.description: The identifier of the act from law_search_acts, for example 1043717.

version.description: A version number from the versions of the act, from 0. Give a version or a date, not both.

date.description: A date, YYYY-MM-DD. Reads the newest version published on or before it.

articles.description: At most 10 article numbers, for example 82 or 133^3. Leave empty for the table of contents.

piece.description: For an act with no articles: the piece of 50,000 characters of its text, from 1. The default is 1.

language.description: The language of the text: ka or en. The default is en. Only ka is official.

tools.name: law_search_acts
tools.description: Searches the legal acts of Georgia in the Legislative Herald (matsne.gov.ge): laws, codes, resolutions, decrees, orders, treaties, and court decisions. Returns 20 acts on a page, each with its identifier, title, document type, issuer, number, signing date, and status, and the total count. The source has no order by relevance: give a type, a status, or an issuer to bring an act to the first page. A Georgian query that equals the full title of an active act puts that act first. Search in Georgian for the best match; an English query matches the titles of translated acts only. Call law_get_act with the identifier to read the act. Data from the Legislative Herald of Georgia.

query.description: The text to find, 1 to 128 characters. Georgian finds every act; English finds translated acts only.

target.description: Where to search: title or text. The default is title.

type.description: A document type: law, parliament_resolution, presidential_decree, government_resolution, government_decree, edict, order, international_treaty, constitutional_court_decision, court_act, self_government_ordinance, self_government_decision, revenue_service_order, individual_legal_act, eu_law, or draft. A code is a law.

status.description: The status of the act: active, expired, or pending.

issuer.description: The body that adopted the act, in the language of the request, for example Parliament of Georgia.

number.description: The number of the act, for example 3591.

order.description: newest or oldest signing date first. The default is newest.

page.description: The page of 20 results, from 1. The default is 1.

language.description: The language of the titles: ka or en. The default is en.

limit.description: The maximum count of acts of the page, 1 to 20. The default is 20.

tools.name: offers_get_offer
tools.description: Returns the full conditions of one offer of a Georgian bank. Use the bank and the id from offers_search_offers. Give the person the url of the offer with the conditions.

bank.description: The bank code of the offer.

language.description: The language of the texts: ka or en. The default is en.

tools.name: offers_search_offers
tools.description: Finds the current offers that Georgian banks give to card holders at partners: discounts, cashback, and points. Filters by bank, customer tier, category, benefit kind, card, and period. For "this month", give the first and the last date of the month. When a bank has a next_offset, call again with that offset to read more. The benefit is the text of the bank. Compare the banks by reading it. Give the person the url of each offer that you name. benefit is the text of the bank. The server reads no number from it: read the percent, the cap, and the conditions from the text. kinds come from a field of the bank, and other means that the bank states none. tiers: standard is every customer, premium the premium package (SOLO at BOG), private the private banking (Wealth Management at BOG), youth the pupils and the students. The banks of this server: bog (Bank of Georgia), liberty (Liberty Bank), tbc (TBC Bank). The card codes of each bank: bog: amex (Amex), mastercard (Mastercard), mastercard_world_elite (Mastercard World Elite), plus (PLUS), scool_card (sCool Card), solo (SOLO), student_card (Student Card), super_plus (Super PLUS), teacher_card (Teacher Card), visa (Visa), visa_infinite (Visa Infinite), visa_platinum (Visa Platinum), visa_signature (Visa Signature); liberty: mastercard (Mastercard), top_card_black (Top|Card Black Edition), visa (Visa); tbc: concept_card (TBC Concept Card), credit_card (Credit Card), crypto (Crypto), installment (Installment), investments (Investments), mastercard (Mastercard), pay_later (Pay Later), pupil_card (Pupil's Card), tbc_card (TBC Card), travel_card (Travel Card), visa (Visa).

banks.description: Bank codes. Empty asks every bank. The description lists the codes.

tiers.description: Customer tiers: standard, premium, private, youth. An offer matches when it has one of them.

categories.description: Offer categories: dining, leisure, travel, health_beauty, auto, transport, shopping, electronics, home, education, kids, entertainment, real_estate, other.

kinds.description: Benefit kinds: discount, cashback, points, other.

cards.description: Card codes of the banks. An offer that names no card matches every card. The description lists the codes of each bank.

from.description: The first date of the period, YYYY-MM-DD. The default is today in Tbilisi.

to.description: The last date of the period, YYYY-MM-DD, at most 366 days after from. The default is from.

query.description: A text to find in the title, the partner, the benefit, or the bank category, 1 to 100 characters.

language.description: The language of the texts: ka or en. The default is en.

limit.description: The maximum count of offers for each bank, 1 to 30. The default is 10.

offset.description: The count of matching offers of each bank to skip, 0 or more. Give the next_offset of a bank to read its next page. The default is 0.

tools.name: parcels_get_parcel
tools.description: Returns one land parcel of the public registry of Georgia by its cadastral code (01.15.05.066.020): the address, the area, the land type, the ownership type, the owners, the registry documents with links to their PDFs, and the centre point. Without a code, find one with parcels_list_nearby_parcels. NAPR publishes every text in Georgian only. Buildings and apartments are not covered. Data from NAPR.

code.description: The cadastral code: 4 or 5 groups of digits with dots, as 01.15.05.066.020.

tools.name: parcels_list_nearby_parcels
tools.description: Returns the land parcels nearest a point in Georgia, nearest first, with the cadastral code, the address, and the distance in metres. The first parcel at 0 metres holds the point. Get the owners and the area with parcels_get_parcel. Addresses are in Georgian. Data from NAPR.

limit.description: The maximum count of parcels, 1 to 20. The default is 5.

tools.name: parcels_search_addresses
tools.description: Finds addresses in the address registry of Georgia, with the municipality and the centre point of each. Write the street and the number in Georgian (ჭავჭავაძის გამზირი 44) and give the municipality (თბილისი): the order of NAPR is poor, and other cities often come first. Pass a centre point to parcels_list_nearby_parcels to find the parcel. Data from NAPR.

query.description: The street and the number, in Georgian or Latin letters.

municipality.description: Only addresses whose municipality holds this text, in Georgian: თბილისი.

limit.description: The maximum count of addresses, 1 to 20. The default is 5.

tools.name: parliament_get_bill
tools.description: Returns one bill by its identifier (32449): its description, its package, and every review stage in order, committee hearings and readings, with dates, yes and no counts, and the identifiers of its votes. Read a vote with parliament_get_vote. Texts are in Georgian. Search in Georgian. Data from the Parliament of Georgia.

id.description: The identifier, from a search or a list, for example 32449.

tools.name: parliament_get_vote
tools.description: Returns one vote by its identifier (31510), with the choice of each member (yes, no, or absent), grouped by faction, with the count of each choice in each faction. Texts are in Georgian. Search in Georgian. Data from the Parliament of Georgia.

id.description: The identifier, from a search or a list, for example 32449.

tools.name: parliament_list_votes
tools.description: Returns the plenary votes in a period, or on bills whose title holds a text, newest first. Each vote has its identifier, date, bill, reading, outcome (adopted or rejected), quorum, and the counts of yes, no, and absent. Read the choice of each member with parliament_get_vote. Texts are in Georgian. Search in Georgian. Data from the Parliament of Georgia.

query.description: A text of the title of the bill, in Georgian, 1 to 128 characters.

from.description: The first date of the vote, YYYY-MM-DD.

to.description: The last date of the vote, YYYY-MM-DD.

page.description: The page, from 1. The default is 1.

limit.description: The count of votes of a page, 1 to 50. The default is 10.

tools.name: parliament_search_bills
tools.description: Returns the bills whose title holds a text, or that the Parliament registered in a period, or that carry a registration number (372/2-XIმპ), newest first. Each bill has its identifier, title, type, registration number and date, initiator, author, and newest review stage. Read the stages and votes with parliament_get_bill. Texts are in Georgian. Search in Georgian. Data from the Parliament of Georgia.

query.description: A text of the title, in Georgian, 1 to 128 characters, for example ბიუჯეტ.

from.description: The first date of registration, YYYY-MM-DD.

to.description: The last date of registration, YYYY-MM-DD.

page.description: The page, from 1. The default is 1.

limit.description: The count of bills of a page, 1 to 50. The default is 10.

tools.name: parliament_search_questions
tools.description: Returns the written questions of members to the bodies of the state, newest first: by a text of the request, by the member (a family name, ხორგუანი), or by a period of registration. Each question has its addressee, deadline, response date, and status: answered, pending, or overdue. The texts of a question and an answer are PDF files on its page. Texts are in Georgian. Search in Georgian. Data from the Parliament of Georgia.

query.description: A text of the request, in Georgian, 1 to 128 characters.

member.description: A name of the member, in Georgian: the family name, or the family name and the first name.

from.description: The first date of registration, YYYY-MM-DD.

to.description: The last date of registration, YYYY-MM-DD.

page.description: The page, from 1. The default is 1.

limit.description: The count of questions of a page, 1 to 50. The default is 10.

tools.name: permits_get_application
tools.description: Returns one application to the Tbilisi Architecture Service by its number (AR11168188): the address, the status, the category, the class, the stages, the deadline, the executor, the text of the decision, and the link to its page. Find a number with permits_search_applications. Texts are in Georgian. Data from TAS.

tools.name: permits_search_applications
tools.description: Returns the applications to the Tbilisi Architecture Service for a parcel or a period, newest first: building permits, project approvals, signs, fences, and requests for public information. Give a cadastral code (01.18.04.020.005), a period of at most 31 days, or both. A period of more than 500 applications fails, and Tbilisi registers about 70 each working day, so ask for a week at most. Each application has its number, address, status, category, class, and stages. Read the decision with permits_get_application. Tbilisi only. Texts are in Georgian. Data from TAS.

code.description: The cadastral code of the parcel: 4 or 5 groups of digits with dots, as 01.18.04.020.005.

from.description: The first date of registration, YYYY-MM-DD. Without to, the period is 7 days.

to.description: The last date of registration, YYYY-MM-DD. Without from, the period is 7 days.

limit.description: The maximum count of applications, 1 to 50. The default is 10.

tools.name: postal_search_codes
tools.description: Finds the postal codes of Georgian Post for an address, a street, a town, or a village of Georgia, by text in Georgian or English. Returns each matching address with its 4-digit postal code and its district. Georgian Post gives a postal code for each street in Tbilisi, Batumi, and Kutaisi only. For another town or a village, search its name. Data from the web page of Georgian Post.

query.description: An address, a street, a town, or a village of Georgia, in Georgian or English. 3 to 100 characters.

language.description: The language of the addresses: ka or en. The default is en.

limit.description: The maximum count of addresses, 1 to 100. The default is 20.

tools.name: rates_get_commercial_rates
tools.description: Returns the current commercial exchange rates of Georgian banks: the prices in GEL at which a bank buys and sells one unit of a currency. Use it for the price of a currency at a bank today, or to compare banks. Ask for 1 to 10 currencies. buy: the price in GEL that the bank pays when you sell it one unit. sell: the price in GEL that the bank asks when you buy one unit from it. The banks of this server: basisbank (Basisbank), bog (Bank of Georgia), credo (Credo Bank), crystal (Crystal, a microfinance organization), halyk (Halyk Bank), inteli (Inteli Express, a microfinance organization), kursi (Kursi.ge, an online exchange bureau), liberty (Liberty Bank), mbc (MBC, a microfinance organization), mjc (MJC, a microfinance organization), rico (Rico Credit, a microfinance organization), scapp (Scapp, a microfinance organization), tbc (TBC Bank), terabank (Terabank). The list gives the kind of each one that is not a bank. The rates are of today. The tool has no history.

currencies.description: 1 to 10 ISO 4217 codes, for example USD and EUR.

banks.description: Bank codes. Empty asks every bank. The description of the tool lists the codes.

tools.name: rates_get_official_rates
tools.description: Returns the official exchange rates of the lari that the National Bank of Georgia (NBG) sets, for one date. Use it for the rate of a currency today or on a past date, for a contract, an invoice, or a tax form. Each rate is the price in GEL of `quantity` units; `rate_per_unit` is the price of one unit. The NBG publishes the rates of each business day at about 17:00 Tbilisi time, in force from the next day until the next set. A weekend or a holiday returns the set in force on it. The official rate is indicative. It is not the price of a bank.

currencies.description: ISO 4217 codes, for example USD and EUR. Empty returns every currency. At most 50.

date.description: The date in YYYY-MM-DD, in Tbilisi. Empty means today. At most the valid date of the newest set: tomorrow after about 17:00.

language.description: The language of the currency names: en or ka. Empty means en.

tools.name: rates_list_official_history
tools.description: Returns the official exchange rates of one currency over a period of up to 31 days, as set by the National Bank of Georgia (NBG). Use it for the movement of a currency over a week or a month. The answer holds one point for each set in force in the period, the set in force on the first day included. Each rate is the price in GEL of `quantity` units.

currency.description: One ISO 4217 code, for example USD.

from.description: The first date of the period, YYYY-MM-DD.

to.description: The last date of the period, YYYY-MM-DD. At most 31 days after from, counted with both ends.

language.description: The language of the currency name: en or ka. Empty means en.

tools.name: stats_get_cells
tools.description: Returns the figures of one table of Geostat for a selection: value codes, or the last values, for each dimension. A dimension with no selection takes every value. Selects at most 1000 cells. An unpublished figure is null. The title of the table names the unit. Data from Geostat.

code.description: The code of a table, from stats_search_tables.

dimension.description: The code of a dimension, from stats_get_table.

values.description: The codes of the values. Give values or last, not both.

last.description: The count of the last values of the dimension, the newest for a time dimension.

selection.description: The values of each dimension. A dimension that this list omits takes every value.

language.description: The language of the texts: ka or en. The default is en.

tools.name: stats_get_inflation
tools.description: Returns the inflation of Georgia for one month, in percent: annual (to the same month of the previous year), monthly (to the previous month), the 12 month average, and core inflation. For the whole country, a city, and a price group. The default is the newest published month. Data from the consumer price index of Geostat.

month.description: The month, YYYY-MM. The default is the newest published month.

region.description: georgia, tbilisi, kutaisi, batumi, gori, telavi, or zugdidi. The default is georgia.

group.description: The price group: total, food, alcohol_tobacco, clothing, housing, furnishings, health, transport, communication, recreation, education, restaurants, or miscellaneous. The default is total.

language.description: The language of the names: ka or en. The default is en.

tools.name: stats_get_table
tools.description: Returns the title and the dimensions of one table of Geostat, with the code and the text of each value. Read it before stats_get_cells. The values of a time dimension go from the oldest to the newest. A table has no unit field: the title names it. Data from Geostat.

code.description: The code of a table, from stats_search_tables: Social Statistics/Labour/Wages_Region.px.

language.description: The language of the texts: ka or en. The default is en.

tools.name: stats_search_tables
tools.description: Finds the tables of Geostat, the National Statistics Office of Georgia, whose title or folder holds every word of a text: for example prices, salaries, population, GDP, and trade. Returns the code, the title, the folder, and the update date of each table, the newest first. Then call stats_get_table with a code. Data from Geostat.

query.description: The words to find in the title or the folder of a table, in the language of the request. 1 to 100 characters.

language.description: The language of the titles: ka or en. The default is en.

limit.description: The maximum count of tables, 1 to 100. The default is 20.

tools.name: transit_get_route
tools.description: Returns a route of the TTC with each direction: its headsign and its stops in order.

route.description: The route number (385) or the route id.

kind.description: The kind, when two routes share the number: bus, minibus, metro, or cable_car.

language.description: The language of the names: ka or en. The default is en.

tools.name: transit_get_timetable
tools.description: Returns the planned departure times of one direction of a route of the TTC at one stop, on a date of the current week. A time of 24:00 or later is after midnight, on the next date.

route.description: The route number (385) or the route id.

stop.description: The stop id or the stop code. The stop must be on the direction.

kind.description: The kind, when two routes share the number: bus, minibus, metro, or cable_car.

direction.description: The direction number from transit_get_route. Required when the route has two directions.

date.description: The date, YYYY-MM-DD, in the current week. The default is today in Tbilisi.

language.description: The language of the names: ka or en. The default is en.

tools.name: transit_list_arrivals
tools.description: Lists the next vehicles of the TTC at a stop: route number, kind, headsign, minutes from as_of, and the expected instant. live is true when the TTC tracks the vehicle; else the time comes from the timetable. With a route, lists the next vehicles of that route only.

stop.description: The stop id (1:1000) or the stop code (1000).

route.description: Only this route: its number (385) or its id. Empty gives the next vehicle of each route.

language.description: The language of the names: ka or en. The default is en.

limit.description: The maximum count of arrivals, 1 to 30. The default is 10.

tools.name: transit_list_nearby_stops
tools.description: Lists the stops of the TTC within a distance of a point in Tbilisi, nearest first, with the distance in metres. Use transit_search_places to get the coordinates of a place.

lat.description: The latitude of the point, in degrees.

lon.description: The longitude of the point, in degrees.

radius_m.description: The distance from the point in metres, 1 to 2000. The default is 500.

kind.description: Only stops of this kind: bus, metro, or cable_car. Empty gives every kind.

language.description: The language of the names: ka or en. The default is en.

limit.description: The maximum count of stops, 1 to 50. The default is 10.

tools.name: transit_plan_trip
tools.description: Plans a trip by public transport of the TTC in Tbilisi between two points, given as coordinates. Returns up to 3 itineraries with each leg: walk or ride, route, stops, instants, distance in metres. Use transit_search_places to get coordinates.

timing.description: leave_now, depart_at, or arrive_by. The default is leave_now.

date.description: The date of depart_at or arrive_by, YYYY-MM-DD. The default is today in Tbilisi.

time.description: The time of depart_at or arrive_by, HH:MM in Tbilisi. Required with them.

kinds.description: The kinds to ride: bus, minibus, metro, cable_car. bus and minibus go together. Empty gives every kind. A walk is always allowed.

preference.description: fastest, less_walking, or fewer_transfers. The default is fastest.

language.description: The language of the names: ka or en. The default is en.

tools.name: transit_search_places
tools.description: Finds places in Tbilisi (addresses, streets, buildings) by text, with their coordinates, for transit_plan_trip and transit_list_nearby_stops. Data from OpenStreetMap through the TTC.

query.description: An address, a street, or a building in Tbilisi.

language.description: The language of the names: ka or en. The default is en.

limit.description: The maximum count of places, 1 to 20. The default is 5.

tools.name: transit_search_routes
tools.description: Finds the routes of the TTC by number or by name. Kinds: bus, minibus, metro, cable_car. With no query, lists every route.

query.description: A route number or a part of a route name. Empty gives every route.

kind.description: Only routes of this kind: bus, minibus, metro, or cable_car.

language.description: The language of the names: ka or en. The default is en.

limit.description: The maximum count of routes, 1 to 100. The default is 20.

tools.name: transit_search_stops
tools.description: Finds the stops of the Tbilisi Transport Company (bus stops, metro stations, cable car stations) by name or stop code, in Georgian or English. Use the stop id of the result with transit_list_arrivals or transit_get_timetable.

query.description: A stop name or a stop code, in Georgian or English.

kind.description: Only stops of this kind: bus, metro, or cable_car. Empty gives every kind.

language.description: The language of the names: ka or en. The default is en.

limit.description: The maximum count of stops, 1 to 50. The default is 10.
